_note: Illustrative persona/style presets for assembly with scripts/format_style_prompt.py. These are generic, hand-written genre descriptions — NOT official Suno data, endpoints, or documented limits. Tune freely per song.

presets.name: acoustic-ballad
presets.style_prompt: acoustic ballad, fingerpicked guitar, warm strings, intimate close vocals, gentle dynamics, heartfelt
presets.notes: Weddings/farewells. Keep chorus lines short (6-8 syllables) so they sing slowly.

presets.name: synth-pop
presets.style_prompt: synth-pop, analog synth pads, bright arpeggios, gated drum machine, 80s retro polish, driving bass
presets.notes: Good base for bittersweet nostalgia; pair with pre-chorus lift into a big chorus.

presets.name: city-pop
presets.style_prompt: city pop, 80s japanese pop groove, funk bass, electric piano, warm brass stabs, smooth saxophone solo
presets.notes: Night-drive melancholy works well; suits bilingual (CJK + English) toplines.

presets.name: trap
presets.style_prompt: trap, booming 808 bass, rolling hi-hats, dark piano melody, sparse beat, hard-hitting drums
presets.vocal: male, melodic rap with sung hooks
presets.notes: Half-time feel at 140 BPM; meter verses tightly, hooks can repeat one punch line.

presets.name: indie-rock
presets.style_prompt: indie rock, jangly guitars, driving bass, live drums, lo-fi warmth, anthemic wide chorus
presets.notes: Contrast quiet verses with loud open-chord choruses; doubles well on the last chorus.

presets.name: lo-fi
presets.style_prompt: lo-fi hip hop, dusty drums, vinyl crackle, mellow electric piano, warm bass, relaxed swing
presets.notes: Study/chill context; mark [Instrumental Break] sections explicitly in the lyric sheet.

presets.name: cinematic-orchestral
presets.style_prompt: cinematic orchestral, sweeping strings, epic percussion, choir pads, slow emotional build, wide reverb
presets.notes: Trailer/closer energy; structure should breathe — long intro and bridge are fine.

presets.name: k-pop
presets.style_prompt: k-pop, punchy synths, hybrid trap drop, catchy topline, layered group vocals, chant hooks, polished production
presets.vocal: mixed group, bright lead, unison chant chorus
presets.notes: Section-switching is a feature: expect pre-chorus, dance break ([Instrumental Break]), rap verse.

presets.name: mandopop
presets.style_prompt: mandopop, lush piano, warm string bed, gentle R&B groove, emotional ballad build
presets.notes: CJK lyrics: count one syllable per character with syllable_meter.py --lang cjk.

presets.name: dangdut
presets.style_prompt: dangdut, driving kendang rhythm, bright flute melody, pentatonic hooks, upbeat dance groove
presets.notes: Call-and-response hooks land well; keep verses conversational, chorus repetitive.
